title: TB financing shocks: replacement of US funding for tuberculosis in 2025, and spending per RR-TB patient, from data reported to WHO
description:
Reproducible, pre-registered analyses of tuberculosis financing reported by national programmes to the World Health Organization.

(1) Country by country, how much of the 2024-2025 fall in USAID funding for national TB programmes was offset by domestic, Global Fund and other funding. (2) How spending per patient treated for rifampicin-resistant TB changed between 2017 and 2024, relative to adoption of the 6-month BPaL/BPaLM regimen.

Contains the analyses (standard-library Python), analysis plans committed before results with dated deviation logs, a pre-registered novelty search, and checks tying each manuscript's tables and numbers to the code. Inputs are WHO public data and WHO report-repository files, read from the companion repository provenance-weighted-priority-setting and verified by SHA-256; WHO's unlicensed repository files are not redistributed. Manuscripts are added on acceptance.
